defects: The 'N' in SUBSTATION has a red diagonal sliver in its counter/stroke. It shows in the opening frame and in the 100% crop, and reads as a glow or mask artifact, not as design.
The panel shots are near-static holds. Across 1/6 s the only change is the gauge needle moving a few degrees, so the name, switch and plate are dead for most of each shot.
Every artist panel uses the same template: same layout, same glow, same switch and gauge. Only the name and circuit number change. That is one move repeated six or more times.
The vertical scroll transitions use a uniform directional blur and show no visible ease or overshoot. The panels slide as a rigid strip with no weight, no settle and no overlap between elements.
In the end stack the panel names are thumbnails a few pixels high and can't be read. The payoff frame is a thin sliver with large empty dark areas on both sides.
The 5.0 s final shot runs long. After the reveal it is mostly a static hold with no secondary motion.
The accent on HÉCTOR crowds the cap height and the line spacing. Two-line names are set with very tight leading.
The glow halo is the same strength on every name, so it adds no hierarchy and slightly softens the edges of the letters.
Mid-transition frames (KIA/IDA ENGBERG) are motion-blurred to near-mush with mismatched panel offsets, so they don't work as freeze frames.
gaps: Motion: the switchboard idea is never acted out. The switch is never thrown, the needle never swings, nothing surges along the copper bus to power each name. Top studio work would make each artist reveal a mechanical event with anticipation, impact and settle, timed to the kick, and vary that event from panel to panel instead of scrolling a fixed template.

Sound: the spectrogram shows a sparse four-on-the-floor kick with a hat tick, one linear white-noise riser, a hard cut and then a bare sub section. Generated-feeling, with no Foley-level sound design (relay clacks, switch throws, electrical hum or arcing, meter ticks) to sell the material world, and little variation in dynamics or texture beyond the single riser.

Finish and payoff: fix the glow artifact on the N. Let type properties carry meaning, for example glow intensity or needle position tracking billing or set time. Build the ending as a readable, composed lockup rather than a 5 s hold on an illegible thumbnail column.
